EuropeOxford_MapScripts::
	map_script MAP_SCRIPT_ON_TRANSITION, EuropeOxford_OnTransition
	.byte 0

EuropeOxford_OnTransition::
	setrespawn HEAL_LOCATION_EUROPE_OXFORD
	end

EuropeOxford_Guide::
	lock
	faceplayer
	msgbox EuropeOxford_Text_Welcome
	goto EuropeChallenge_Oxford

EuropeOxford_ClinicSign::
	msgbox EuropeLondon_Text_Clinic, MSGBOX_SIGN
	end

EuropeOxford_StationSign::
	msgbox EuropeOxford_Text_Station, MSGBOX_SIGN
	end

EuropeOxford_RouteSign::
	msgbox EuropeOxford_Text_Route, MSGBOX_SIGN
	end

EuropeOxford_Landmark::
	msgbox EuropeOxford_Text_Landmark, MSGBOX_SIGN
	end

EuropeOxford_Text_Welcome::
	.string "Welcome to OXFORD! Rest your team\n"
	.string "at the clinic after the long trail.\p"
	.string "Follow the path south through the\n"
	.string "meadow, or take a train to LONDON.\p"
	.string "The three-city stamp tour still\n"
	.string "visits LONDON, PARIS, and BERLIN.$"

EuropeOxford_Text_Station::
	.string "OXFORD STATION\nEuropean rail ticket office.\p"
	.string "GYM: north of the town square.\n"
	.string "ADA waits east of the town guide.$"

EuropeOxford_Text_Route::
	.string "SOUTH: OXFORD TRAIL\nThen ENGLISH MEADOW and LONDON.$"

EuropeOxford_Text_Landmark::
	.string "OXFORD GARDEN WALK\nA quiet rest for traveling partners.$"

EuropeChallenge_Oxford::
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_ENGLAND_CHALLENGE, 1, EuropeChallenge_Complete
	setvar VAR_0x8005, 0
	call_if_defeated TRAINER_EUROPE_OLIVER, EuropeTour_CountStamp
	call_if_defeated TRAINER_EUROPE_ALICE, EuropeTour_CountStamp
	goto_if_eq VAR_0x8005, 2, EuropeChallenge_Oxford_Reward
	buffernumberstring STR_VAR_1, VAR_0x8005
	msgbox EuropeChallenge_Oxford_Progress
	release
	end
EuropeChallenge_Oxford_Reward::
	checkitemspace ITEM_RARE_CANDY, 1
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, FALSE, EuropeChallenge_BagFull
	msgbox EuropeChallenge_Text_Reward
	giveitem ITEM_RARE_CANDY, 1
	setvar VAR_EUROPE_ENGLAND_CHALLENGE, 1
	goto EuropeChallenge_Complete
EuropeChallenge_Oxford_Progress::
	.string "Regional trail wins: {STR_VAR_1} of 2.\p"
	.string "Meet OLIVER in ENGLISH MEADOW.\n"
	.string "Meet ALICE on this town's trail.\p"
	.string "Win both friendly matches, then\n"
	.string "return here for one RARE CANDY!$"

EuropeOxford_GymSign::
	msgbox EuropeOxfordGym_Text_Statue, MSGBOX_SIGN
	end

EuropeOxford_RealismRadcliffe::
	msgbox EuropeOxford_RealismRadcliffeText, MSGBOX_SIGN
	end

EuropeOxford_RealismRadcliffeText::
	.string "RADCLIFFE SQUARE\n"
	.string "The domed RADCLIFFE CAMERA library.$"

EuropeOxford_RealismMagdalen::
	msgbox EuropeOxford_RealismMagdalenText, MSGBOX_SIGN
	end

EuropeOxford_RealismMagdalenText::
	.string "MAGDALEN TOWER / HIGH STREET\n"
	.string "MAGDALEN BRIDGE crosses the CHERWELL.$"

EuropeOxford_RealismMeadow::

	end

EuropeOxford_RealismMeadowText::
	.string "CHERWELL MEADOW PATH\n"
	.string "Follow the river back to HIGH STREET.$"

data/maps/EuropeOxfordGym/scripts.inc:
EuropeOxfordGym_MapScripts::
	.byte 0

EuropeOxfordGym_Leader::
	lock
	faceplayer
	goto_if_defeated TRAINER_EUROPE_LEADER_ELLIS, EuropeOxfordGym_Reward
	goto_if_ne VAR_EUROPE_ENGLAND_STORY, 2, EuropeOxfordGym_NotReady
	msgbox EuropeOxfordGym_Text_Offer, MSGBOX_YESNO
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, NO, EuropeOxfordGym_Decline
	trainerbattle_single TRAINER_EUROPE_LEADER_ELLIS, EuropeOxfordGym_Text_Intro, EuropeOxfordGym_Text_Defeat, EuropeOxfordGym_Victory
	goto EuropeOxfordGym_Reward
EuropeOxfordGym_Victory::
	setflag FLAG_BADGE01_GET
	msgbox EuropeOxfordGym_Text_Badge
EuropeOxfordGym_Reward::
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_OXFORD_TM, 1, EuropeOxfordGym_Complete
	checkitem ITEM_TM_CASE, 1
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, TRUE, EuropeOxfordGym_CheckTM
	checkitemspace ITEM_TM_CASE, 1
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, FALSE, EuropeOxfordGym_Full
EuropeOxfordGym_CheckTM::
	checkitemspace ITEM_TM39, 1
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, FALSE, EuropeOxfordGym_Full
	giveitem ITEM_TM39, 1
	setvar VAR_EUROPE_OXFORD_TM, 1
EuropeOxfordGym_Complete::
	msgbox EuropeOxfordGym_Text_Complete
	goto EuropeOxfordGym_End
EuropeOxfordGym_Full::
	msgbox EuropeOxfordGym_Text_Full
	goto EuropeOxfordGym_End
EuropeOxfordGym_NotReady::
	msgbox EuropeOxfordGym_Text_NotReady
	goto EuropeOxfordGym_End
EuropeOxfordGym_Decline::
	msgbox EuropeOxfordGym_Text_Decline
EuropeOxfordGym_End::
	release
	end

EuropeOxfordGym_Guide::
	lock
	faceplayer
	msgbox EuropeOxfordGym_Text_Advice
	goto EuropeOxfordGym_End
EuropeOxfordGym_Statue::
	lockall
	goto_if_defeated TRAINER_EUROPE_LEADER_ELLIS, EuropeOxfordGym_Winner
	msgbox EuropeOxfordGym_Text_Statue
	releaseall
	end
EuropeOxfordGym_Winner::
	msgbox EuropeOxfordGym_Text_Winner
	releaseall
	end
EuropeOxfordGym_Text_Offer::
	.string "I'm ELLIS, OXFORD's GYM LEADER.\p"
	.string "OAK's study taught you to travel\n"
	.string "and grow alongside your partners.\p"
	.string "Now test that bond against ROCK!\n"
	.string "Are you ready for a GYM battle?$"
EuropeOxfordGym_Text_Intro::
	.string "Build your victory on solid ground!$"
EuropeOxfordGym_Text_Defeat::
	.string "Your teamwork has a firm foundation!$"
EuropeOxfordGym_Text_Badge::
	.string "You've earned the BOULDERBADGE!\p"
	.string "Your first badge is now recorded\n"
	.string "on your TRAINER CARD.$"
EuropeOxfordGym_Text_Complete::
	.string "TM39 teaches ROCK TOMB.\n"
	.string "It damages and slows the target.\p"
	.string "A TM can be used only once.\n"
	.string "Choose its partner with care!\p"
	.string "CELINE in PARIS seeks field helpers.\n"
	.string "Your badge is a good introduction!$"
EuropeOxfordGym_Text_Full::
	.string "Your badge is safe! Make room\n"
	.string "for TM39, then speak to me again.$"
EuropeOxfordGym_Text_NotReady::
	.string "Before this match, finish OAK's\n"
	.string "ENGLAND field study.\p"
	.string "His aide waits in LONDON's square.\n"
	.string "Return after delivering your report.$"
EuropeOxfordGym_Text_Decline::
	.string "Prepare your team. I'll wait here.\n"
	.string "The clinic offers free healing.$"
EuropeOxfordGym_Text_Advice::
	.string "ELLIS uses ROCK-type partners:\n"
	.string "GEODUDE Lv.10 and ONIX Lv.12.\p"
	.string "GRASS and WATER moves work well.\n"
	.string "TACKLE alone will be a tough climb!\p"
	.string "ODDISH lives on the English trails.\n"
	.string "Raise a team and bring POTIONS.\p"
	.string "First, finish OAK's field study\n"
	.string "and report to his LONDON aide.$"
EuropeOxfordGym_Text_Statue::
	.string "OXFORD GYM\nLEADER: ELLIS\p"
	.string "A firm foundation for every team.$"
EuropeOxfordGym_Text_Winner::
	.string "OXFORD GYM\nLEADER: ELLIS\p"
	.string "Winning trainer: {PLAYER}$"

EuropeOranienburgGym_Leader::
	lock
	faceplayer
	goto_if_defeated TRAINER_EUROPE_LEADER_CONRAD, EuropeOranienburgGym_Reward
	goto_if_ne VAR_EUROPE_GERMANY_STORY, 3, EuropeOranienburgGym_NotReady
	msgbox EuropeOranienburgGym_Text_Offer, MSGBOX_YESNO
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, NO, EuropeOranienburgGym_Decline
	trainerbattle_single TRAINER_EUROPE_LEADER_CONRAD, EuropeOranienburgGym_Text_Intro, EuropeOranienburgGym_Text_Defeat, EuropeOranienburgGym_Victory
	goto EuropeOranienburgGym_Reward
EuropeOranienburgGym_Victory::
	setflag FLAG_BADGE03_GET
	msgbox EuropeOranienburgGym_Text_Badge
EuropeOranienburgGym_Reward::
	goto_if_eq VAR_EUROPE_ORANIENBURG_TM, 1, EuropeOranienburgGym_Complete
	checkitem ITEM_TM_CASE, 1
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, TRUE, EuropeOranienburgGym_CheckTM
	checkitemspace ITEM_TM_CASE, 1
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, FALSE, EuropeOranienburgGym_Full
EuropeOranienburgGym_CheckTM::
	checkitemspace ITEM_TM34, 1
	goto_if_eq VAR_RESULT, FALSE, EuropeOranienburgGym_Full
	giveitem ITEM_TM34, 1
	setvar VAR_EUROPE_ORANIENBURG_TM, 1
EuropeOranienburgGym_Complete::
	msgbox EuropeOranienburgGym_Text_Complete
	goto EuropeOranienburgGym_End
EuropeOranienburgGym_Full::
	msgbox EuropeOranienburgGym_Text_Full
	goto EuropeOranienburgGym_End
EuropeOranienburgGym_NotReady::
	msgbox EuropeOranienburgGym_Text_NotReady
	goto EuropeOranienburgGym_End
EuropeOranienburgGym_Decline::
	msgbox EuropeOranienburgGym_Text_Decline
EuropeOranienburgGym_End::
	release
	end

EuropeOranienburgGym_Guide::
	lock
	faceplayer
	msgbox EuropeOranienburgGym_Text_Advice
	goto EuropeOranienburgGym_End
EuropeOranienburgGym_Statue::
	lockall
	goto_if_defeated TRAINER_EUROPE_LEADER_CONRAD, EuropeOranienburgGym_Winner
	msgbox EuropeOranienburgGym_Text_Statue
	releaseall
	end
EuropeOranienburgGym_Winner::
	msgbox EuropeOranienburgGym_Text_Winner
	releaseall
	end
EuropeOranienburgGym_Text_Offer::
	.string "I'm CONRAD, this town's GYM LEADER.\n"
	.string "LENA told me about your delivery.\p"
	.string "Reliable partners make connections!\n"
	.string "Ready for an ELECTRIC-type battle?$"
EuropeOranienburgGym_Text_Intro::
	.string "Let's put your teamwork to the test!$"
EuropeOranienburgGym_Text_Defeat::
	.string "Your team has a powerful connection!$"
EuropeOranienburgGym_Text_Badge::
	.string "You've earned the THUNDERBADGE!\n"
	.string "Your third badge is now recorded\p"
	.string "on your TRAINER CARD.$"
EuropeOranienburgGym_Text_Complete::
	.string "TM34 teaches SHOCK WAVE.\n"
	.string "Its electric attack never misses.\p"
	.string "GROUND types are still immune.\n"
	.string "A TM can be used only once.\p"
	.string "Three badges from three countries!\n"
	.string "River captains in LONDON and OXFORD\n"
	.string "now welcome you aboard for free!$"
EuropeOranienburgGym_Text_Full::
	.string "Your badge is safe! Make room\n"
	.string "for TM34, then speak to me again.$"
EuropeOranienburgGym_Text_NotReady::
	.string "First, finish LENA's delivery.\n"
	.string "She waits west of BERLIN's guide.\p"
	.string "Bring KARL's report back to her\n"
	.string "and collect your MAGNET reward.$"
EuropeOranienburgGym_Text_Decline::
	.string "Prepare your team. I'll wait here.\n"
	.string "The clinic offers free healing.$"
EuropeOranienburgGym_Text_Advice::
	.string "CONRAD uses ELECTRIC partners:\n"
	.string "VOLTORB Lv.14 and PIKACHU Lv.16.\p"
	.string "GROUND moves are strong here.\n"
	.string "GRASS resists ELECTRIC attacks.\p"
	.string "WATER and FLYING partners beware!\n"
	.string "Raise a team and bring POTIONS.\p"
	.string "First, finish LENA's delivery\n"
	.string "and collect her reward in BERLIN.$"
EuropeOranienburgGym_Text_Statue::
	.string "ORANIENBURG GYM\n"
	.string "LEADER: CONRAD\p"
	.string "Teamwork makes strong connections.$"
EuropeOranienburgGym_Text_Winner::
	.string "ORANIENBURG GYM\n"
	.string "LEADER: CONRAD\p"
	.string "Winning trainer: {PLAYER}$"
